name: Formal pc-Minor Basis for Spread Ample Classes
statement: A finite ample class is spread ample if and only if none of its pc-minors is isomorphic to a member of $\mathcal B_{\mathrm{spr}}$, the family of all pc-minor-minimal non-spread ample classes.
proof: Spread ampleness is inherited by pc-minors. If a finite ample class is not spread, repeatedly take a proper non-spread pc-minor; each step removes a coordinate, so the process terminates at a pc-minimal non-spread ample class.
comments: Completeness is formal: this record does not assert that the obstruction family has a finite or explicit classification.
